plainTranslation: Someone's planet on your South Node - your comfort zone, the already-familiar - feels like you've known them for years inside ten minutes. Instant, easy, regressive. The recognition is real. So is the pull backward. Comfort isn't the same as good for you.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
